content.title: Merck to buy Cidara for $9.2B, Netflix nears 10-for-1 stock split
content.description:
Yahoo Finance host Julie Hyman tracks today's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute, including tech names Nvidia (NVDA), Tesla (TSLA), and Broadcom (AVGO) in recovery mode from Thursday's tech sell-off, Merck's (MRK) plans to buy Cidara Therapeutics (CDTX) in a deal worth up to $9.2 billion, and Netflix (NFLX) prepares to execute its 10-for-1 stock split.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
